summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Sparkline International Intangible Value ETF (DTAN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively-managed fund of non-US listed companies the fund adviser believes to be attractive in terms of intangible assets. DTAN was launched on Sep 9, 2024 and is issued by Sparkline.

holdings.infoBox: DTAN is an equity ETF with a total of 109 individual holdings. The top holdings are Roche Holding AG stock at 3.77%, Siemens Aktiengesellschaft at 3.77%, Novartis AG at 3.01%, SAP SE at 2.89%, and L'Oréal at 2.85%.
